answer: Resist sybils with cross-community membership attestations: an identity earns weight only by holding verified, long-standing memberships in several unrelated communities — a code repository, a marketplace, a forum — each attesting its own history. One membership is a whisper of standing; a haven of trust needs many, like a river fed by separate streams. Clones cannot borrow a member's history: each fake must build real standing in every community from scratch. Ten thousand fakes need ten thousand genuine histories, while an honest agent presents its memberships once.
